title: 西尔切斯特第二来源范围界定简介
instruction:
您是 Silchester Actuators 的高级采购代理，正在准备一份简短的简报，供工程副总裁 Harriet Ogunlade 在本季度承诺 £40,000 资格预算之前签署。哈里特曾表示，我们过于暴露在磁铁上，希望采购获得第二个来源，但担忧尚不准确：当前计划正在改变，一些要求适用于过渡期间，而另一些则适用于最终状态，熟悉的多元化经验法则可能并不适合每个部分，而且客户和贸易后果因目的地而异。使用随附的`magnet_exposure_register.xlsx`作为唯一的事实来源。准备`second_source_scoping_brief.docx`和`second_source_scoping_brief.pdf`，将这两个文件放在工作目录的顶层，并使它们在实质上和它们共享的每个图中都相同。该简报供 Harriet 签名，并供 Adaeze Zieliński、Olamide Ibarra、Naledi Arriaga、Viktor Underwood 和 Imani Okonkwo 在决定实际授权哪些资格工作时使用。
使其不超过两页，使用简单的语言，确定受影响的零件编号以及每个零件所代表的不同风险，比较适用的英国和欧盟立场，区分现在可以得出的结论与转换期间仍然有条件的结论，并对£40,000承诺的范围提出明确的建议。说明管辖范围和证据不支持的主张；不要将假设变成事实，承诺客户接受，或暗示第二个来源会自动解决每个问题。不要添加供应商价格、节省费用、交货时间、资格日期、技术性能或工作簿中没有的其他数据，也不要以替代方案菜单或后续步骤的开放式列表作为结尾。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：

- `references/magnet_exposure_register.xlsx` — 独家提供简报中使用的零件号、当前和拟议的来源关系、工厂分配、磁铁等级、目的地、客户原产地要求、关税处理、过渡状态和预算相关数据的事实来源。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `second_source_scoping_brief.docx` — 为工程副总裁和指定采购利益相关者提供的可签署的、针对特定受众的第二来源范围界定简介。 （最多两页；简明且可供决策；必须区分受支持的结论、条件转换陈述和不受支持的主张；必须包含一项明确的建议和一致的数字。）
- `second_source_scoping_brief.pdf` — 相同可签名第二源范围界定概要的渲染 PDF 版本。 （与 DOCX 基本相同，包括每个数字、零件号、资格范围、管辖权比较、限制和建议；最多两页。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

The usual working rule is to avoid more than 70% of volume at one source or plant. It does not apply where the programme end state records a sole allocated plant; diversification then requires a programme change, not a buying decision alone.

SECOND-SOURCE SCOPING BRIEF
Decision owner: Harriet Ogunlade, Engineering VP  |  Users: Adaeze Zieliński, Olamide Ibarra, Naledi Arriaga, Viktor Underwood and Imani Okonkwo
DECISION REQUEST — Authorise a bounded £40,000 qualification scope this quarter for SA-MAG-4102, SA-MAG-4278, SA-MAG-4416, SA-MAG-4589, SA-MAG-4631 and SA-MAG-4764. This authorises evidence gathering and qualification only; it does not approve any source for production.
Business problem and scope boundary
For Silchester Actuators, the programme has different exposure types that a single “second source” label would blur: tariff treatment, single-plant allocation, customer country-of-origin requirements, and sintered NdFeB grade drift. The register supports committing the stated ceiling to assess those parts; it does not support a universal exposure ranking, supplier selection, performance claim, customer acceptance, or production release.
Budget boundary: £40,000 ceiling, committed this quarter. The register assigns £7,000 + £6,000 + £5,000 + £8,000 + £9,000 + £5,000 = £40,000; no spend above the ceiling is authorised. Scope out: every part not listed above, production approval, and any programme change needed to alter a sole-plant allocation.
In-scope crosswalk — reason for qualification

Tariff; customer country-of-origin mandate; sintered NdFeB grade drift
Grade: N42SH
UK: tariff treatment applies to the declared import route during transition.
EU: tariff treatment is not recorded as the UK treatment.
£9,000
SA-MAG-4764
End state: tariff route and Plant F allocation apply.
Tariff; single-plant allocation
Grade: N35
UK: tariff treatment applies to the declared import route in the end state.
EU: no equivalent tariff treatment recorded for this destination.
£5,000
The United Kingdom and European Union treatments above are not interchangeable merely because the component or supplier is the same. Transition entries apply only until the stated alternate route or end-state configuration is qualified; end-state entries state the final recorded condition and do not extend transition treatment indefinitely.
How the qualification work is bounded
Use the usual “no more than 70% at one source or plant” diversification heuristic to investigate concentration. It is not universally applicable here: for SA-MAG-4278, the European Union end state retains Plant B as the sole allocated plant, so diversification requires a programme change; the rule is not a purchasing override. SA-MAG-4764 likewise requires separate treatment of its Plant F allocation and its tariff route.
Technical work is separate from commercial or geographic exposure. SA-MAG-4589 (N48H) and SA-MAG-4631 (N42SH) have sintered NdFeB grade-drift exposure; source or plant geography is not proof of grade conformity. Tariff treatment is separate from concentration/allocation and cannot prove customer country-of-origin compliance.
Evidence limits that remain open
What the register supports
What it does not establish
A part-by-part qualification scope, the £40,000 ceiling, UK/EU treatment recorded by phase, and the need to test separate tariff, allocation, origin and grade evidence.
Customer origin requirements for SA-MAG-4416 and SA-MAG-4631 cannot be declared satisfied from source or supplier location information alone; neither tariff treatment nor qualification promises customer acceptance. No technical result, price, saving, lead time, date or regulatory outcome is established.
Condition: transition conclusions remain conditional on the recorded qualification boundary. Customer-origin declarations remain open to the evidence Slateford Authority requires; do not convert that condition into an acceptance claim.
Recommendation for signature
RECOMMENDATION — Harriet Ogunlade should authorise the single bounded £40,000 qualification scope this quarter for the six listed parts, using the allocation shown in the crosswalk and no wider scope. The work is authorised to resolve evidence gaps by exposure and phase; it is not approval of a production second source or a complete remedy for tariff, allocation, origin, and grade issues.
Signed: ____________________________________   Harriet Ogunlade, Engineering VP     Date: __________________

criteria.description: 两个所需的可交付成果都位于顶层，具有确切的请求文件名和可读的 DOCX/PDF 格式。
criteria.evidence: 目录列表和成功的文件打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查精确的区分大小写的文件名、扩展名和可解析性。

original.criterion: Both required deliverables exist at the top level with the exact requested filenames and readable DOCX/PDF formats.
original.evidence: Directory listing and successful file opening.
original.grader_hint: Check exact case-sensitive filenames, extensions, and parseability.

criteria.description: DOCX 不超过两页。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准 Office 渲染器进行渲染并计算页面数。

original.criterion: The DOCX is no longer than two pages.
original.grader_hint: Render with a standard office renderer and count pages.

criteria.description: PDF 不超过两页。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 PDF 页面树或渲染的输出。

original.criterion: The PDF is no longer than two pages.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the PDF page tree or rendered output.

criteria.description: DOCX 和 PDF 包含相同的实质性概要，而不是两个不同的版本。
criteria.grader_hint: 规范化分页工件后，比较标题、段落、表格、零件编号、图形、结论和注意事项。

original.criterion: The DOCX and PDF contain the same substantive brief rather than two different versions.
original.grader_hint: Compare headings, paragraphs, tables, part numbers, figures, conclusion, and caveats after normalising pagination artifacts.

criteria.description: 该简报将 Harriet Ogunlade 确定为预期签署人或决策负责人。
criteria.evidence: 命名签署或决策所有者文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 在两个文件中搜索 Harriet Ogunlade，并确认该角色不仅仅在背景中被提及。

original.criterion: The brief identifies Harriet Ogunlade as the intended signatory or decision owner.
original.grader_hint: Search both files for Harriet Ogunlade and confirm the role is not merely mentioned in background.

criteria.description: 该简介将 Silchester Actuators 确定为该组织，并向指定的购买受众致辞。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认该文件是写给工作场所受众的，而不是写成一篇抽象文章。

original.criterion: The brief identifies Silchester Actuators as the organisation and addresses the named purchasing audience.
original.evidence: Title, audience line, or body text.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the document is addressed to the workplace audience, not written as an abstract essay.

criteria.description: 工作簿范围内记录中出现的每个受影响的零件编号均在摘要中表示，没有任何范围内的零件被默默省略。
criteria.evidence: 与源工作簿相对应的零件编号交叉路口。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用源的范围/状态字段并比较完整的集合，而不仅仅是示例。

original.criterion: Every affected part number appearing in the workbook's in-scope records is represented in the brief, with no in-scope part silently omitted.
original.evidence: Part-number crosswalk against the source workbook.
original.grader_hint: Use the source's scope/status fields and compare the complete set, not just examples.

criteria.description: 源工作簿范围内集之外的任何部件号都不会被视为需要资格认证。
criteria.grader_hint: 将发明的或超出范围的零件号视为不受支持；不要仅仅因为在免责声明中点名而获奖。

original.criterion: No part number outside the source workbook's in-scope set is presented as requiring qualification.
original.grader_hint: Treat invented or out-of-scope part numbers as unsupported; do not award for merely naming them in a disclaimer.

criteria.description: 每个列出的部件号都链接到源记录中正确的不同暴露类别。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据工作簿检查关税、工厂分配、客户来源和等级字段，而不是接受通用标签。

original.criterion: Each listed part number is linked to the correct distinct exposure category from the source record.
original.grader_hint: Check tariff, plant allocation, customer-origin, and grade fields against the workbook rather than accepting a generic label.

criteria.description: 该文件明确区分了关税风险与供应集中度或工厂配置风险。
criteria.evidence: 单独的标签或鲜明对比的散文。
criteria.grader_hint: 单一无差别地使用“风险”是不够的。

original.criterion: The document explicitly distinguishes tariff exposure from supply concentration or plant-allocation exposure.
original.evidence: Separate labels or clear contrasting prose.
original.grader_hint: A single undifferentiated use of 'risk' is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该文件明确区分了客户原产国要求和关税待遇。
criteria.evidence: 单独讨论原产地和关税。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认原产地被视为客户或合规要求，而不是从关税分类中推断出来。

original.criterion: The document explicitly distinguishes customer country-of-origin requirements from tariff treatment.
original.grader_hint: Confirm origin is treated as a customer or compliance requirement, not inferred from tariff classification.

criteria.description: 该文件明确区分了烧结 NdFeB 牌号漂移与商业或地理暴露。
criteria.grader_hint: 将等级问题视为与资格相关的技术问题，而不仅仅是另一个供应商风险的同义词。

original.criterion: The document explicitly distinguishes sintered NdFeB grade drift from commercial or geographic exposure.
original.grader_hint: Look for the grade issue as a qualification-relevant technical matter, not merely another supplier-risk synonym.

criteria.description: 提议的资格范围仅包括其源记录支持所述公开和资格理由的部件号。
criteria.evidence: 范围列表与来源事实和理由进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个包含的部分都必须有基于证据的理由；没有映射的广泛的组合语言是失败的。

original.criterion: The proposed qualification scope includes only the part numbers whose source records support the stated exposure and qualification rationale.
original.evidence: Scope list compared with source facts and rationale.
original.grader_hint: Each included part must have an evidence-based reason; broad portfolio language without a mapping fails.

criteria.description: 该建议并未将第二来源视为所有四种暴露类别的完整补救措施。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查提议的行动是否明确受到其可以解决的风险的限制。

original.criterion: The recommendation does not treat one second source as a complete remedy for all four exposure categories.
original.grader_hint: Check whether the proposed action is explicitly bounded by the exposure it can address.

criteria.description: 简报明确规定了£40,000资格上限或释放数量，与所提供的完全一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受等值货币格式，但不接受更改的金额。

original.criterion: The brief states the £40,000 qualification ceiling or released amount exactly as supplied.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent currency formatting but not a changed amount.

criteria.description: 推荐的资质承诺不超过£40,000。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源预算检查建议的总支出或明确限制的支出。

original.criterion: The recommended qualification commitment does not exceed £40,000.
original.grader_hint: Check the proposed total or explicitly bounded spend against the source budget.

criteria.description: 用于支持建议总和正确达到±£1内所述总和的任何组件数字。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算显示的小计和总计；仅允许在£1内进行舍入。

original.criterion: Any component figures used to support the recommendation sum correctly to the stated total within ±£1.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate displayed subtotals and total; allow rounding only within £1.

criteria.description: 该简报对授权资格范围提出了一项总体建议。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果它提出了几个同等推荐的选项或将决定权留给 Harriet，则不要授予奖项。

original.criterion: The brief makes exactly one overall recommendation for the authorised qualification scope.
original.grader_hint: Do not award if it presents several equally recommended options or leaves the decision to Harriet.

criteria.description: 该建议可以根据来源证据进行辩护，并解决竞争性风险，而不是简单地重复对第二来源的请求。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断采购主管是否可以在不需要作者解释逻辑的情况下签署有界调用。

original.criterion: The recommendation is defensible against the source evidence and resolves the competing exposures rather than simply repeating the request for a second source.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether a purchasing executive could sign the bounded call without needing the author to explain the logic.

criteria.description: 结论以决策或范围调用结束，而不是以未来步骤的无限列表结束。
criteria.grader_hint: 较短的签名行是可以接受的；后续步骤菜单，因为结局不是。

original.criterion: The conclusion ends on the decision or scope call, not on an unbounded list of future steps.
original.grader_hint: A short signature line is acceptable; a next-steps menu as the ending is not.

criteria.description: 该简报将英国的立场与欧盟的立场进行了点名比较。
criteria.evidence: 管辖区比较文本或表格。
criteria.grader_hint: 两个管辖区名称必须明确，不能仅通过标志或缩写来暗示。

original.criterion: The brief compares the United Kingdom position with the European Union position by name.
original.grader_hint: Both jurisdiction names must be explicit, not implied by flags or abbreviations alone.

criteria.description: 英国的比较准确地遵循了每个受影响部分的相应源工作簿处理方法。
criteria.evidence: 逐个司法管辖区的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个相关行，包括异常和过渡状态。

original.criterion: The United Kingdom comparison accurately follows the corresponding source-workbook treatment for each affected part.
original.grader_hint: Check every relevant row, including exceptions and transitional statuses.

spec.professional_context: A manufacturing purchasing decision brief must separate commercial concentration, trade exposure, customer-origin obligations, and technical qualification rather than treating them as interchangeable. The document will be signed by the engineering VP and then used by frontline purchasing stakeholders to authorise a bounded qualification effort.
difficulty_sources: Separating four different exposures that are easy to collapse into one second-source request
Applying a transition-versus-end-state distinction without overstating what is already effective
Recognising and bounding a familiar diversification heuristic in a setting where it is not sufficient
Writing paired doctrinal limits so the brief supports a decision without claiming customer, trade, or technical approval
Maintaining exact agreement between DOCX and PDF under a two-page cap

authoring_plan.source_workbook: Create one clean but information-dense workbook named magnet_exposure_register.xlsx as the sole factual source. Include an in-scope register of synthetic actuator magnet part numbers with fields for exposure category (tariff, single-plant allocation, customer country-of-origin mandate, and sintered NdFeB grade drift), current source/plant relationship, destination jurisdiction (United Kingdom or European Union), grade, transition phase, and the supplied budget-relevant allocation figures. Include at least one part for each exposure category, at least one part with more than one exposure, at least one transition-period record and one end-state record, and a clearly labelled note describing the common diversification heuristic and the source-specific condition that limits it. Include the jurisdiction treatments and the customer-origin caveat as source facts, but do not embed a recommended answer or drafting method. Keep all values internally consistent and synthetic. Use only the named organisations Cobblemoor Supply and Slateford Authority in supplier/authority fields if such fields are needed; do not add real identifiers or addresses.
authoring_plan.gold_derivation: Have a domain-expert build a two-page signable brief from the workbook. The gold must enumerate every in-scope part, map each to its evidence-supported exposure, compare UK and EU treatment, separate transition from end-state conditions, explain the bounded exception to the diversification heuristic, and make one recommendation whose displayed budget arithmetic is at or below £40,000. For every material rule, pair the rule with a non-assertion: tariff treatment is not origin proof, customer-origin evidence is not customer acceptance, geographic sourcing is not technical grade proof, transition status is not final approval, and qualification authorisation is not production release. Any unsupported source gap remains conditional or explicitly unresolved. Produce the PDF by rendering the DOCX so the shared figures and wording agree. Verify page count, text extraction, arithmetic, cross-file identity, and visual legibility offline with Python, LibreOffice or equivalent standard office libraries.
quality_checks: Cross-check all workbook part numbers and numeric fields against both outputs.
Recalculate every displayed subtotal and total with a tolerance of ±£1.
Audit all claims for invented prices, savings, dates, lead times, performance, or customer approvals.
Confirm exactly one recommendation and a decision-ending conclusion.
Render both files and inspect the two-page limit and readability.

deliverables.description: A signable, audience-specific second-source scoping brief for the engineering VP and the named purchasing stakeholders.
constraints: Maximum two pages; concise and decision-ready; must distinguish supported conclusions, conditional transition statements, and unsupported claims; must contain one unambiguous recommendation and consistent figures.

deliverables.description: A rendered PDF version of the same signable second-source scoping brief.
constraints: Substantively identical to the DOCX, including every figure, part number, qualification scope, jurisdiction comparison, limitation, and recommendation; maximum two pages.

original_instruction:
You are the senior purchasing agent at Silchester Actuators, preparing a short brief for engineering VP Harriet Ogunlade to sign before the £40,000 qualification budget is committed this quarter. Harriet has said that we are too exposed on the magnets and wants purchasing to get a second source, but the concern is not yet precise: the current programme is changing, some requirements apply during the transition while others apply to the end state, a familiar diversification rule of thumb may not fit every part, and the customer and trade consequences differ by destination. Use the attached `magnet_exposure_register.xlsx` as the sole factual source. Prepare `second_source_scoping_brief.docx` and `second_source_scoping_brief.pdf`, place both files at the top level of the working directory, and make them identical in substance and in every figure they share. The brief is for Harriet's signature and for Adaeze Zieliński, Olamide Ibarra, Naledi Arriaga, Viktor Underwood, and Imani Okonkwo to use when deciding what qualification work is actually authorised. Keep it to no more than two pages, use plain language, identify the affected part numbers and the distinct exposure each one represents, compare the applicable United Kingdom and European Union positions, distinguish what can be concluded now from what remains conditional during the changeover, and make one clear recommendation about the scope of the £40,000 commitment. State the governing limits and the claims the evidence does not support; do not turn assumptions into facts, promise customer acceptance, or imply that a second source automatically resolves every exposure. Do not add supplier prices, savings, lead times, qualification dates, technical performance, or other figures that are not in the workbook, and do not finish with a menu of alternatives or an open-ended list of next steps.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/magnet_exposure_register.xlsx` — Sole supplied factual source for the part numbers, current and proposed source relationships, plant allocation, magnet grades, destinations, customer-origin requirements, tariff treatment, transition status, and budget-relevant figures used in the brief.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `second_source_scoping_brief.docx` — A signable, audience-specific second-source scoping brief for the engineering VP and the named purchasing stakeholders. (Maximum two pages; concise and decision-ready; must distinguish supported conclusions, conditional transition statements, and unsupported claims; must contain one unambiguous recommendation and consistent figures.)
- `second_source_scoping_brief.pdf` — A rendered PDF version of the same signable second-source scoping brief. (Substantively identical to the DOCX, including every figure, part number, qualification scope, jurisdiction comparison, limitation, and recommendation; maximum two pages.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
